妙蛙种子。在出生后的一段时间内，它会吸收背上种子里储存着的营养成长。: Bulbasaur. For a while after birth, it grows by absorbing nutrients stored in the seed on its back.
妙蛙草。沐浴在阳光下越久，身体内会涌出越多力量，背上的花苞也会渐渐成长。: Ivysaur. The longer it bathes in sunlight, the more energy fills its body and the more the bud on its back grows.
妙蛙花。花朵散发出的迷人香味能安抚激动的心情，甚至消弭斗争。: Venusaur. The lovely scent of its flower calms excited feelings and can even stop a fight.
小火龙。尾巴上的小火苗，就像它的活力信号。精神饱满时，火焰也会明亮地摇动。: Charmander. The little flame on its tail shows its energy. When it feels lively, the flame dances brightly too.
火恐龙。挥动有力的尾巴，喷出热热的火焰。小火龙长大后，多了几分神气。: Charmeleon. It swings its strong tail and breathes hot flames. As Charmander grows, it looks more confident.
喷火龙。能用翅膀飞到距地面１４００米的高度。会吐出高温火焰。: Charizard. It can fly 1,400 meters above the ground and breathes intensely hot flames.
杰尼龟。当它遇到危险的时候，会将四肢收回龟壳里保护自己，同时从嘴里喷出水来。: Squirtle. When danger comes, it pulls its limbs into its shell for protection and sprays water from its mouth.
卡咪龟。会灵巧地摆动自己毛茸茸的耳朵和尾巴，借此在水中保持平衡。: Wartortle. It deftly moves its fluffy ears and tail to balance in the water.
水箭龟。从龟壳上的大炮里放出的喷射水流足以贯穿厚实的铁板。: Blastoise. The jets of water from the cannons on its shell can pierce thick iron plates.
绿毛虫。别看它的脚很短，因为是吸盘，所以无论是斜坡还是墙壁都能轻松前进。: Caterpie. Its legs may be short, but they have suction cups, letting it move easily up slopes and walls.
铁甲蛹。安静的外壳里，正发生着了不起的变化。成长有时也需要好好等待。: Metapod. Something amazing is happening inside that quiet shell. Growing sometimes means waiting patiently.
巴大蝶。每天都忙着采集花蜜。习惯往腿部的细毛上涂满花蜜，然后带回巢穴里。: Butterfree. It spends every day gathering nectar, coating the fine hairs on its legs before carrying it back to the nest.
独角虫。头上长有尖锐的针。它喜欢藏在森林或草丛里大量吞食树叶。: Weedle. It has a sharp stinger on its head. It likes hiding in forests and grass while eating lots of leaves.
铁壳蛹。它把自己包在坚实的壳里，静静准备下一次蜕变。: Kakuna. Wrapped in a sturdy shell, it quietly prepares for its next transformation.
大针蜂。扇动翅膀在树林间飞行，手臂上有醒目的尖针。观察它时记得保持距离。: Beedrill. It flaps through the trees with sharp stingers on its arms. Keep your distance when watching it.
波波。性格沉着冷静，即使受到攻击也很少反击，只会朝对手扬起沙子保护自己。: Pidgey. Calm and composed, it rarely fights back even when attacked. It only kicks up sand to protect itself.
比比鸟。拥有超群的体力，而且飞翔范围广，经常飞到很远的地方寻找食物。: Pidgeotto. It has outstanding stamina and a wide flying range, often traveling far to find food.
大比鸟。宽大的翅膀让它成为飞行高手，能从高空看见远处的动静。: Pidgeot. Its broad wings make it an excellent flier, able to spot movement far away from high in the sky.
小拉达。小小的身体配着醒目的大门牙，活跃的它总能找到藏身的地方。: Rattata. A tiny body with large front teeth, this lively Pokémon always finds somewhere to hide.
拉达。它的后脚上长着小蹼，以便它在水中游泳寻找食物。: Raticate. Small webs on its hind feet help it swim in search of food.
烈雀。它喜欢贴近地面灵活飞行，用响亮的叫声提醒同伴。: Spearow. It flies nimbly close to the ground and alerts its friends with loud cries.
大嘴雀。很久以前就存在的宝可梦。哪怕只察觉到一丝危险，都会立即飞向高空。: Fearow. A Pokémon that has existed since long ago. At even the slightest hint of danger, it flies high into the sky.
阿柏蛇。身体会随着年龄增长不断变长。每到夜里，它会一圈圈地将身体缠绕在树枝上休息: Ekans. Its body grows longer as it ages. At night, it coils around tree branches to rest.
阿柏怪。展开颈部时，会露出特别的花纹。不同地方的阿柏怪，花纹也可能不同。: Arbok. When it spreads its hood, a special pattern appears. Arbok from different places may have different patterns.
皮卡丘。皮卡丘们把尾巴贴在一起交换电流，其实是在互相打招呼。: Pikachu. When Pikachu touch tails and exchange electricity, they are greeting one another.
雷丘。如果电囊空了，它就会直直地竖起尾巴，收集空气中的电流。: Raichu. When its electric sacs run empty, it holds its tail straight up to collect electricity from the air.
穿山鼠。会在地上挖洞建造巢穴。挖洞时，即便遇到地里的坚硬岩石，也能用尖锐的爪子弄: Sandshrew. It digs burrows in the ground. Even hard rocks cannot stop its sharp claws from breaking through and digging on.
穿山王。会将锐利的爪子钩在树上爬树。这是为了设法使树果掉落，分给等在树下的穿山鼠: Sandslash. It hooks its sharp claws into trees and climbs them to knock down berries for the Sandshrew waiting below.
尼多兰。用坚硬的门牙咬碎树果吃。和雄性相比，角的尖端稍圆一些。: Nidoran♀. It cracks berries with its hard front teeth. Compared with the male, its horn tip is slightly rounder.
尼多娜。如果族群遇到了危险，会和伙伴们团结起来，施展出超音波大合唱。: Nidorina. If the group is in danger, they band together and perform a chorus of ultrasonic waves.
尼多后。把孩子放在背上刺与刺的空隙里来哄它们。在这时绝对不会释放毒素。: Nidoqueen. It soothes its young by carrying them between the spines on its back. It never releases poison while doing this.
尼多朗。虽然个头不大，却是个勇敢的伙伴。大耳朵帮助它听见周围的声音。: Nidoran♂. Small but brave, this partner uses its large ears to listen to sounds nearby.
尼多力诺。它的耳朵很灵敏，能留意草丛里的小小动静。头上的角是醒目的标志。: Nidorino. Its sensitive ears pick up tiny movements in the grass. The horn on its head is a distinctive feature.
尼多王。强壮的尾巴帮助它保持平衡。魁梧的外表，让它看起来十分威风。: Nidoking. Its strong tail helps it balance. Its sturdy build gives it an impressive presence.
皮皮。因可爱的举止和叫声而广受欢迎的宝可梦。不过很少被人发现。: Clefairy. A Pokémon loved for its cute behavior and cries, although it is rarely seen.
皮可西。听觉灵敏，连１公里以外针落地的声音都听得见，因此平时会待在安静的地方。: Clefable. Its hearing is so sharp that it can hear a pin drop a kilometer away, so it usually stays in quiet places.
六尾。随着身体的成长，６根尾巴的毛发也会变得更漂亮。紧紧抱着它时能感到微微的温暖: Vulpix. As it grows, the fur on its six tails becomes more beautiful. Hugging it feels gently warm.
九尾。九条金色的尾巴轻轻展开，显得优雅又神秘。它也是非常聪明的伙伴。: Ninetales. Its nine golden tails fan out gently, giving it an elegant, mysterious air. It is also very clever.
胖丁。能够随意改变声音的波长，唱出听了绝对会犯困的神奇旋律。: Jigglypuff. It can change the wavelength of its voice at will, singing a magical melody that always makes listeners sleepy.
胖可丁。以自己细腻的体毛为傲。尤其是额头上的卷毛，更是有着天堂般的极致触感。: Wigglytuff. It is proud of its fine, soft fur. The curl on its forehead feels especially heavenly to touch.
超音蝠。栖息在晒不到阳光的洞窟里。到了早晨便会和同伴聚集起来，一边互相取暖一边睡: Zubat. It lives in caves away from sunlight. In the morning, it gathers with its companions to sleep and keep one another warm.
大嘴蝠。张开宽宽的翅膀，在夜晚轻巧飞行。洞窟是它熟悉的家。: Golbat. It spreads its broad wings and flies lightly through the night. Caves are its familiar home.
走路草。白天会为躲避太阳而钻入凉爽的地下。会通过沐浴月光成长。: Oddish. It burrows into cool earth to avoid the sun during the day and grows by bathing in moonlight.
臭臭花。看似口水的东西其实是甜甜的蜜。非常黏稠，只要碰到就会一直黏住。: Gloom. What looks like drool is actually sweet nectar. It is so sticky that anything touching it stays stuck.
霸王花。虽然花瓣越大，就能放出越多的花粉，但这样脑袋会变沉，容易疲倦。: Vileplume. Bigger petals release more pollen, but they also make its head heavier and tire it out.
派拉斯。背上长着两朵小蘑菇，喜欢在树根附近挖洞。仔细找找阴凉的地方吧。: Paras. Two little mushrooms grow on its back. It likes burrowing near tree roots. Look carefully in shady places.
派拉斯特。背上的大蘑菇非常醒目，像撑开了一把小伞。它喜欢潮湿阴凉的环境。: Parasect. The large mushroom on its back looks like an open umbrella. It likes damp, shady places.
毛球。在明亮的地方你便能发现它具有雷达功能的大眼其实是由许多个小眼睛聚集而成的。: Venonat. In bright light, you can see that its big radar-like eyes are made of many tiny eyes.
摩鲁蛾。翅膀上覆盖着细细的鳞粉，飞起来轻盈又安静。远远观察就很好。: Venomoth. Fine scales cover its wings, letting it fly lightly and quietly. Watching from a distance is best.
地鼠。在地下较浅的地方移动。被它挖掘过的地面会鼓起来，所以非常容易发现。: Diglett. It moves just below the surface. The ground bulges where it digs, making it easy to spot.
三地鼠。三胞胎的地鼠，拥有能够挖掘到地下１００公里深的潜力。没人知道它在地下的部: Dugtrio. A trio of Diglett with the potential to burrow 100 kilometers underground. Nobody knows what they look like below the surface.
喵喵。额头上的金币闪闪发亮，它也喜欢收集亮晶晶的小东西。: Meowth. The coin on its forehead shines brightly, and it loves collecting little sparkling things.
猫老大。走路时轻盈优雅，胡须十分灵敏，是个很有气质的伙伴。: Persian. It walks lightly and elegantly. Its sensitive whiskers add to its refined air.
可达鸭。常常抱着脑袋发呆，看起来迷迷糊糊，却藏着不可思议的力量。: Psyduck. It often holds its head and looks dazed, yet incredible power is hidden inside.
哥达鸭。脚上的蹼帮助它轻松游泳，在水里能展现灵巧的身手。: Golduck. Webbed feet help it swim easily and move nimbly underwater.
猴怪。它身手轻巧，能在树间活动。情绪激动时，蓬松的毛也会跟着竖起来。: Mankey. It moves lightly through trees. When excited, its fluffy fur stands on end.
火暴猴。它充满力量和干劲，行动非常迅速。认识它时要给它一点自己的空间。: Primeape. Full of energy and strength, it moves very quickly. Give it a little space when you meet it.
卡蒂狗。忠诚又勇敢，喜欢陪在信任的人身边。鼻子和耳朵都很灵敏。: Growlithe. Loyal and brave, it likes staying near people it trusts. Its nose and ears are very sensitive.
风速狗。从古时候起就是俘获了众多人心的美丽宝可梦。能像飞一样轻巧地奔跑。: Arcanine. A beautiful Pokémon that has captured hearts since ancient times. It runs as lightly as if it were flying.
蚊香蝌蚪。在水流湍急的河里，会把厚厚的嘴唇像吸盘那样紧紧吸在岩石上避免被冲走。: Poliwag. In fast-flowing rivers, it sticks its thick lips to rocks like suction cups to avoid being swept away.
蚊香君。流出的汗是黏滑的粘液状。即使被敌人捉住，也能哧溜一下滑走逃脱。: Poliwhirl. Its sweat is a slippery slime. Even if an enemy grabs it, it can slip away and escape.
蚊香泳士。它不仅是游泳高手，还拥有结实有力的手臂。胸前的旋涡很有辨识度。: Poliwrath. It is an excellent swimmer with strong, sturdy arms. The spiral on its chest is easy to recognize.
凯西。能够在睡梦中使出瞬间移动。据说它睡得越熟，就能移动到越遥远的地方。: Abra. It can teleport while asleep. The deeper it sleeps, the farther it is said to travel.
勇基拉。念力的威力大得惊人。会把精神力量储存在额头的星星里，以备进化之需。: Kadabra. Its psychic power is astonishing. It stores mental energy in the star on its forehead to prepare for evolution.
胡地。会操纵强大的超能力。据说它双手握着的汤勺就是用那力量制造出来的。: Alakazam. It controls powerful psychic energy. The spoons it holds in both hands are said to be made with that power.
腕力。时时刻刻都充满力量。由于体力过剩而去举起岩石消磨时间，也因此变得更强。: Machop. Always full of energy, it lifts rocks to pass the time and grows even stronger as a result.
豪力。有着不会疲劳的强韧肉体。会去帮助人类完成例如搬运沉重行李之类的工作。: Machoke. Its tough body never seems to tire. It helps people with jobs such as carrying heavy loads.
怪力。四条强壮的手臂配合默契，能同时完成不同的动作。: Machamp. Its four strong arms work together smoothly, carrying out different actions at the same time.
喇叭芽。喜欢温度高，有一定湿度的地方。它会用身上的藤蔓抓小虫来吃。: Bellsprout. It likes warm places with some humidity and catches small bugs with its vines.
口呆花。像一只会活动的小铃铛，喜欢温暖潮湿的地方。头顶的叶子很醒目。: Weepinbell. Like a little walking bell, it likes warm, damp places. The leaves on its head stand out.
大食花。大大的叶子和甜甜的香气，是它独特的标志。它喜欢热闹茂密的丛林。: Victreebel. Its large leaves and sweet scent make it distinctive. It likes lively, lush jungles.
玛瑙水母。身体的大部分由水组成。在海中，会和海水混为一体，非常难以发现。: Tentacool. Most of its body is water. In the sea, it blends into the water and is very hard to spot.
毒刺水母。许多长长的触手能自在伸缩，帮助它在海里灵活活动。: Tentacruel. Its many long tentacles stretch freely, helping it move nimbly through the sea.
小拳石。常常待在山路旁，看起来像一块圆圆的石头。路过时留心脚下，别打扰它。: Geodude. Often found beside mountain paths, it looks like a round rock. Watch your step and don't disturb it.
隆隆石。圆滚滚的身体适合沿着山坡滚动，它的手臂也非常有力。: Graveler. Its round body is perfect for rolling down slopes, and its arms are very strong too.
隆隆岩。刚蜕皮时浑身都白白的非常柔软，但是接触到空气之后会迅速变坚硬。: Golem. Right after shedding, its whole body is soft and white, but it quickly hardens on contact with air.
小火马。得到了小火马认可的人，在触摸它燃烧着的鬃毛时不会觉得烫手，真是不可思议。: Ponyta. Amazingly, anyone Ponyta accepts can touch its fiery mane without getting burned.
烈焰马。奔跑速度最快的烈焰马会成为首领，决定族群前往的地点和奔跑速度。: Rapidash. The fastest Rapidash becomes the leader, deciding where the herd goes and how fast it runs.
呆呆兽。把尾巴泡在水里后会有甜味渗出，因此它会以尾巴为诱饵吸引宝可梦并将其钓起。: Slowpoke. When it dips its tail in water, sweetness seeps out. It uses its tail as bait to lure and catch Pokémon.
呆壳兽。因为被大舌贝咬住而受到的刺激使它变得能够两足直立行走。当大舌贝离开后，它: Slowbro. The stimulation from Shellder's bite lets it stand and walk on two legs. If Shellder leaves, it seems to turn back into Slowpoke.
小磁怪。靠吃电来维持生命。会一边从左右两边的组件放射电磁波一边在空中飞行。: Magnemite. It lives on electricity and flies through the air while emitting electromagnetic waves from the units on either side.
三合一磁怪。会不断释放很强的的磁力。在三合一磁怪接近时，大多数电脑都会发生异常情: Magneton. It constantly releases a powerful magnetic force. Most computers malfunction when Magneton comes near.
大葱鸭。用植物的茎来战斗。茎的挥舞方式存在着好几种不同的流派。: Farfetch’d. It battles with a plant stalk. There are several different schools of stalk-swinging technique.
嘟嘟。羽毛较短所以不擅长飞行，但是拥有发达的双脚，能够以很快的速度奔跑。: Doduo. Its short feathers make flying difficult, but its powerful legs let it run very fast.
嘟嘟利。由嘟嘟的某个头分裂出的变种。以60千米的时速在草原上奔跑。: Dodrio. A variant formed when one of Doduo's heads split. It runs across grasslands at 60 kilometers per hour.
小海狮。喜欢天寒地冻的地方，就算零下10度也能愉快地游泳。: Seel. It loves freezing places and swims happily even at minus 10 degrees.
白海狮。全身像雪一样白。十分耐寒，即使是在有浮冰的大海里也能很精神地游来游去。: Dewgong. Its whole body is snow-white. It handles the cold so well that it swims cheerfully even among drifting sea ice.
臭泥。它有柔软的身体，能穿过很窄的缝隙。保持环境清洁，是观察它时想到的小提醒。: Grimer. Its soft body can pass through narrow gaps. Watching it reminds us to keep our surroundings clean.
臭臭泥。身体软软的，可以自由改变形状。它有很特别的气味，适合保持距离观察。: Muk. Its soft body changes shape freely. It has a distinctive smell, so watching from a distance is best.
大舌贝。两片结实的贝壳保护着身体，常常能看到它悄悄伸出的小舌头。: Shellder. Two tough shells protect its body. You can often spot its little tongue peeking out.
刺甲贝。厚厚的壳能牢牢闭合，像一座小小的海底堡垒。: Cloyster. Its thick shell closes tightly, like a little fortress under the sea.
鬼斯。能用稀薄气体状的身体潜入任何地方，但只要起风就会被吹跑。: Gastly. Its thin, gaseous body lets it slip anywhere, but a breeze can blow it away.
鬼斯通。它喜欢躲在暗处，伸出轻飘飘的手，像个爱玩捉迷藏的伙伴。: Haunter. It likes hiding in the dark and reaching out with its floating hands, like a playful hide-and-seek partner.
耿鬼。圆圆的身体配着大大的笑容，喜欢藏在影子里，是个神秘的捉迷藏高手。: Gengar. A round body and a big grin, it likes hiding in shadows and is a mysterious master of hide-and-seek.
大岩蛇。弯曲扭动巨大结实的身体，以时速８０公里的猛烈劲头向前挖进。: Onix. It twists its huge, sturdy body and digs forward at a powerful 80 kilometers per hour.
催眠貘。如果你每晚与它一起睡觉，它偶尔会让你梦见它以前吃过的梦。: Drowzee. If you sleep beside it every night, it may sometimes show you dreams it ate before.
引梦貘人。手里拿着轻轻摇摆的钟摆，擅长神奇的催眠本领。: Hypno. It holds a gently swinging pendulum and is skilled at mysterious hypnosis.
大钳蟹。如果危险逼近，就会从嘴里吐出泡沫包裹全身，让身体看起来更大。: Krabby. When danger approaches, it blows bubbles around itself to look bigger.
巨钳蟹。一只大钳子特别醒目，是它引以为傲的本领。它喜欢待在海边。: Kingler. Its enormous claw is its pride and joy. It likes to live by the sea.
霹雳电球。圆圆的外形让人容易认错，身体里储存着电能。观察时不要突然惊动它。: Voltorb. Its round shape can fool people, and its body stores electricity. Be careful not to startle it while watching.
顽皮雷弹。圆滚滚又充满电力，表情总像在微笑。它对周围的动静十分敏感。: Electrode. Round and full of electricity, it always seems to smile. It is very sensitive to movement nearby.
蛋蛋。６只不在一起就不安心。哪怕只是少了１只，都会马上想要逃跑。: Exeggcute. It feels uneasy unless all six are together. If even one is missing, it immediately wants to flee.
椰蛋树。３个脑袋联合起来能使出强大的精神力量。天气变阴时动作会变得迟钝。: Exeggutor. Its three heads combine to release powerful psychic energy. It becomes sluggish when the sky clouds over.
卡拉卡拉。戴着特别的骨头头盔，手里握着小骨棒。它会慢慢学着变得勇敢。: Cubone. It wears a special skull helmet and holds a little bone club, slowly learning to be brave.
嘎啦嘎啦。长大后的它更有力量，也更擅长挥动骨棒，展现自己独特的本领。: Marowak. Now grown, it is stronger and more skilled at swinging its bone club, showing off its unique talents.
飞腿郎。有弹性的双腿能伸得很长，平衡能力也是它的拿手好戏。: Hitmonlee. Its springy legs stretch far, and balancing is another of its specialties.
快拳郎。擅长快速挥拳，动作十分利落。认真练习之后，它也需要休息。: Hitmonchan. It throws quick, precise punches. After practicing hard, it needs a rest too.
大舌头。长长的舌头特别灵活，能帮助它探索周围的东西。: Lickitung. Its long, flexible tongue helps it explore things around it.
瓦斯弹。圆圆的身体里装着气体，能够轻轻飘浮。它有独特的生活环境。: Koffing. Its round body holds gas, letting it float gently. It has a very unusual habitat.
双弹瓦斯。两个脑袋相连，能交替处理体内的气体。它的样子很容易辨认。: Weezing. Its two heads are connected and take turns processing gases inside its body. Its shape is easy to recognize.
独角犀牛。结实的身体和鼻子上的小角，让它看起来很有力量。它喜欢直直地向前跑。: Rhyhorn. Its sturdy body and little horn make it look strong. It likes running straight ahead.
钻角犀兽。能用两条腿站立，全身有像铠甲一样结实的皮肤。: Rhydon. It can stand on two legs, and its skin is as tough as armor.
吉利蛋。原本动作迟缓。为了保护蛋不被抢走，逃跑的速度才变快了。: Chansey. It used to move slowly. It became faster at running away to protect its egg from being stolen.
蔓藤怪。藤蔓有着独特的香气。在伽勒尔的部分地区被当做香草使用。: Tangela. Its vines have a distinctive scent. In parts of Galar, they are used as herbs.
袋兽。腹部的育儿袋里住着小宝宝，它会认真守护孩子，让孩子安心成长。: Kangaskhan. A baby lives in its belly pouch. It carefully protects its young so the little one can grow safely.
墨海马。会像跳舞一样在水中游动以制造漩涡。作为娱乐，会和伙伴比拼谁的漩涡更大。: Horsea. It swims as if dancing to create whirlpools. For fun, it competes with friends to make the biggest one.
海刺龙。背上有醒目的尖刺，尾巴能卷住珊瑚，在水中稳稳停留。: Seadra. Its back has striking spines, and its tail curls around coral to hold it steady in the water.
角金鱼。背鳍和尾鳍像肌肉那样发达。能够以５节的速度在水中游泳。: Goldeen. Its dorsal and tail fins are developed like muscles. It can swim at five knots.
金鱼王。金鱼王之所以会用角挖穿河底的岩石来筑巢，是为了防止产下的卵被水流冲走。: Seaking. Seaking hollows out rocks on riverbeds with its horn to make nests, keeping its eggs from being washed away.
海星星。中心有一颗红色核心，五只腕足组成了漂亮的星星形状。: Staryu. A red core shines at its center, with five arms forming a lovely star.
宝石海星。会高速旋转着身体一边游泳一边吸收微小的浮游生物。: Starmie. It spins rapidly while swimming and takes in tiny plankton.
魔墙人偶。擅长表演默剧。用手指放出的波动制造墙壁，保护自己免于大多数攻击。: Mr. Mime. A talented mime, it creates walls with waves from its fingers to protect itself from most attacks.
飞天螳螂。绿色的身体能融入树林，镰刀形的手臂和轻快的动作是它的标志。: Scyther. Its green body blends into the forest. Scythe-shaped arms and nimble movements are its trademarks.
迷唇姐。喜欢有节奏地摇摆身体，独特的声音和动作就像一段表演。: Jynx. It likes swaying to a rhythm. Its unusual voice and movements are like a performance.
电击兽。暴风雨来临时，它们就会集结在高高的大树周围，耐心地等待落雷。: Electabuzz. When a storm approaches, they gather around tall trees and patiently wait for lightning to strike.
鸭嘴火兽。身体带着很高的温度，喜欢炎热的地方，看起来像一团跳动的火焰。: Magmar. Its body is very hot. It likes scorching places and looks like a dancing flame.
凯罗斯。头顶有两只醒目的大角，拥有很强的力量。它喜欢温暖的环境。: Pinsir. Two large horns stand out on its head. It is very strong and likes warm places.
肯泰罗。跑起来充满力量，身后的三条尾巴会跟着摆动。宽阔的草原很适合它。: Tauros. It runs powerfully, its three tails swinging behind it. Wide grasslands suit it well.
鲤鱼王。虽然现在看起来只会蹦跳，但它藏着令人期待的成长可能。: Magikarp. It may seem to do nothing but splash now, but exciting possibilities for growth are hidden inside.
暴鲤龙。长长的身体在水中游动，外表十分威风。很难想象它是由小小的鲤鱼王长大的。: Gyarados. Its long body moves majestically through the water. It is hard to imagine it grew from a little Magikarp.
拉普拉斯。十分耐寒，不畏冰海。皮肤滑滑的，摸上去会有点凉。: Lapras. It handles cold seas with ease. Its smooth skin feels a little cool to touch.
百变怪。当两只百变怪相遇的时候，为了能变成和对方相同的样子，它们动起来会比平常更: Ditto. When two Ditto meet, they move more vigorously than usual as each tries to copy the other.
伊布。由于不稳定的遗传基因，蕴含着各种各样进化可能性的特殊宝可梦。: Eevee. A special Pokémon whose unstable genes hold many different possibilities for evolution.
水伊布。身体细胞的结构与水分子相似。它能和水融为一体，让别人无法看见它。: Vaporeon. Its cells are structured like water molecules. It can merge with water and disappear from sight.
雷伊布。尖尖的毛发能储存电力，兴奋时会发出噼里啪啦的小电光。: Jolteon. Its spiky fur stores electricity and crackles with little sparks when it gets excited.
火伊布。柔软蓬松的毛发能散发热量，颈部像围着一条暖暖的围巾。: Flareon. Its soft, fluffy fur gives off warmth, and its neck looks wrapped in a cozy scarf.
多边兽。近年来十分活跃于电脑空间。到处检查有没有可疑的数据。: Porygon. In recent years, it has been very active in cyberspace, checking everywhere for suspicious data.
菊石兽。来自遥远的古代，背着螺旋形的壳，靠小小的腕足在海中活动。: Omanyte. From the distant past, it carries a spiral shell and moves through the sea on small tentacles.
多刺菊石兽。背上的螺旋壳长出了尖刺，腕足让它能在海底灵活活动。: Omastar. Its spiral shell has grown spikes, and its tentacles help it move nimbly along the seabed.
化石盔。有坚实的外壳，是来自古代海洋的宝可梦。它的故事像一页活着的自然笔记。: Kabuto. An ancient sea Pokémon with a sturdy shell. Its story is like a living page from a nature journal.
镰刀盔。流线形的身体适合游泳，镰刀形的手臂让它非常有辨识度。: Kabutops. Its streamlined body suits swimming, and its scythe-shaped arms make it easy to recognize.
化石翼龙。从远古而来的飞行伙伴，宽大的翅膀让它能够在天空翱翔。: Aerodactyl. A flying partner from ancient times. Its broad wings let it soar through the sky.
卡比兽。喜欢吃饱后舒舒服服地睡觉，圆圆的大身体让它十分好认。: Snorlax. It loves a comfortable nap after a good meal. Its big, round body is easy to recognize.
急冻鸟。拥有能够自由操纵冰的能力。据说它栖息在永久冻土的雪山。: Articuno. It can freely control ice. It is said to live on snowy mountains covered in permanent frost.
闪电鸟。传说的鸟宝可梦。据说只要它一摩擦翅膀，就会立刻发生落雷。: Zapdos. A legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that rubbing its wings together instantly causes lightning to strike.
火焰鸟。相传它会用燃烧着的美丽翅膀照亮山道，救助在此遇险的人。: Moltres. It is said to light mountain paths with its beautiful burning wings and rescue people stranded there.
迷你龙。长久以来被认为只存在于幻想之中。额头小小的突起是正在发育的角。: Dratini. Long thought to exist only in imagination, it has a tiny bump on its forehead that is a developing horn.
哈克龙。把力量集中在尾巴的珠子上操纵天气。散发气场的样子非常神秘。: Dragonair. It focuses power in the pearl on its tail to control the weather. Its glowing aura looks very mysterious.
快龙。被称为大海的化身。很多船都会把快龙的雕像设置在船头。: Dragonite. Called the embodiment of the sea, it inspires many ships to place a Dragonite statue on their bows.
超梦。拥有强大的超能力和与梦幻相近的基因。它的故事里，还有许多等待了解的秘密。: Mewtwo. It has powerful psychic abilities and genes similar to Mew's. Its story still holds many secrets to discover.
梦幻。小小的身体藏着许多不可思议的可能。与所有伙伴相遇后，这份最后的惊喜就会到来: Mew. Its tiny body holds countless possibilities. Meet every other partner, and this final surprise will arrive.
精灵球。红红的上半边。这是最常见的精灵球。训练家用它来尝试捕捉野生宝可梦，和新伙: Poké Ball. A bright red top half. This is the most common Poké Ball. Trainers use it to try to catch wild Pokémon and travel with new partners.
超级球。蓝色球盖，红色条纹。超级球比普通精灵球更容易捕捉到野生宝可梦。不过，投出: Great Ball. A blue lid with red stripes. The Great Ball has a better chance of catching wild Pokémon than a regular Poké Ball. But throwing one still doesn't guarantee success.
高级球。黑色球盖，黄色条纹。高级球通常比超级球更容易捕捉到野生宝可梦。它的黑色和: Ultra Ball. A black lid with yellow stripes. The Ultra Ball usually catches wild Pokémon more easily than the Great Ball. Its black-and-yellow pattern is easy to recognize.
大师球。紫色球盖，上面有个 M。大师球非常珍贵。野外遇到的任何宝可梦，它都能保证: Master Ball. A purple lid with an M on top. The Master Ball is very precious. It guarantees a successful catch of any Pokémon encountered in the wild—even a legendary Pokémon!
狩猎球。绿色球盖，迷彩花纹。狩猎球是在狩猎地带使用的特别精灵球。在那里，训练家用: Safari Ball. A green lid with a camouflage pattern. The Safari Ball is a special Poké Ball used in the Safari Zone. Trainers use it there to try to catch wild Pokémon.
火之石。像藏着一团小火焰。给合适的伙伴使用，就能帮助它进化。在火红和叶绿游戏里，: Fire Stone. It looks as though a tiny flame is held inside. Use it on a compatible partner to help it evolve. In FireRed and LeafGreen, Vulpix evolves into Ninetales using a Fire Stone. Growlithe evolves into Arcanine using a Fire Stone. Eevee evolves into Flareon using a Fire Stone.
水之石。像一滴清亮的水。它能帮助下面这些伙伴进化，不是所有水属性伙伴都需要它。在: Water Stone. Like a clear drop of water. It helps the partners below evolve, but not all Water types need it. In FireRed and LeafGreen, Poliwhirl evolves into Poliwrath using a Water Stone. Shellder evolves into Cloyster using a Water Stone. Staryu evolves into Starmie using a Water Stone. Eevee evolves into Vaporeon using a Water Stone.
雷之石。里面有闪电一样的花纹。皮卡丘和伊布，都能借助它的力量进化。在火红和叶绿游: Thunder Stone. It has a lightning-like pattern inside. Pikachu and Eevee can evolve with its help. In FireRed and LeafGreen, Pikachu evolves into Raichu using a Thunder Stone. Eevee evolves into Jolteon using a Thunder Stone.
叶之石。里面像藏着一片叶子。臭臭花、口呆花和蛋蛋，都能用它进化。在火红和叶绿游戏: Leaf Stone. It looks as though a leaf is held inside. Gloom, Weepinbell, and Exeggcute can use it to evolve. In FireRed and LeafGreen, Gloom evolves into Vileplume using a Leaf Stone. Weepinbell evolves into Victreebel using a Leaf Stone. Exeggcute evolves into Exeggutor using a Leaf Stone.
月之石。这是一块神秘的石头。不是到了晚上就会进化，要把月之石用在合适的伙伴身上。: Moon Stone. This is a mysterious stone. Nightfall alone doesn't cause evolution; use a Moon Stone on a compatible partner. In FireRed and LeafGreen, Nidorina evolves into Nidoqueen using a Moon Stone. Nidorino evolves into Nidoking using a Moon Stone. Clefairy evolves into Clefable using a Moon Stone. Jigglypuff evolves into Wigglytuff using a Moon Stone.

Surge. He specializes in Electric types, with Raichu as his trusted partner. Win to earn the Thunder Badge. The Pokémon introduced here are Voltorb, Pikachu, Raichu.

His game team includes Growlithe, Ponyta, Rapidash, and Arcanine. Defeat him to earn the flame-shaped Volcano Badge. The Pokémon introduced here are Growlithe, Ponyta, Rapidash, Arcanine.

When Ash arrives, Giovanni is away and Team Rocket's trio runs the Gym. They battle using Pokémon Giovanni lent them. Ash defeats them and earns his eighth badge, the Earth Badge. The borrowed Pokémon are Rhydon, Machamp, Kingler. These are the three Pokémon Giovanni lent to Team Rocket's trio, not all of Giovanni's Pokémon.

In the games, he uses a Ground-type team. Return after earning the other seven badges, defeat him, and receive the Earth Badge. The Pokémon introduced here are Rhyhorn, Dugtrio, Nidoqueen, Nidoking, Rhyhorn.
